title: A Unified Framework for Sample Complexity of Structured Quantum State Tomography under Noisy Observations
summary: Quantum state tomography (QST) has attracted considerable attention due to its fundamental role in quantum information processing. In this paper, we develop a unified theoretical framework for analyzing the sample complexity of structured QST under noisy observations arising from state preparation noise, measurement noise, and finite-shot statistical noise.
